description: Interactive fill-in-the-blank tables for CBSE Grade 7 Mathematics (Decimals chapter). Redesigned with Singularity Design System — Poppins font, #4A4DC9 primary / #FF7212 accent palette, pill-shaped buttons, gradient headers (#533086→#FC9145).
subject: Mathematics
chapter: Chapter 3: A Peek Beyond the Point
learning_objectives: Convert between mm and cm using ÷10 / ×10
Convert between cm and m using ÷100 / ×100
Convert between g and kg using ÷1000 / ×1000
Convert between paise and rupees using ÷100 / ×100
Understand decimal place value shifts in unit conversions
teaching_notes: Use AFTER teaching all four conversion types. Start with Table 1 (÷10) and progress to Table 3 (÷1000). Highlight the pattern of zeros matching decimal shifts. Encourage students to check their answers mentally before typing.
instructions_for_student: Complete all four tables using the correct conversion factor. The tool checks your answer immediately! Type your answer in the blue box and press Enter or click away to check.

additionalProps.description: Tool-specific dynamic content for unit conversion tables

subtitle.default: Complete all four tables using the correct conversion factor!

tables.description: Array of conversion tables. Each uses DS colors: Table1=#4A4DC9, Table2=#533086, Table3=#FF7212, Table4=#FC9145
